messages.subject: Browser differences?
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to deploy my shiny app live using the shiny server and have encountered a few problems.  My sire is here for now http://172.25.253.196:3838/

First, the choice in browser seems to matter for file uploads.  I can open files using Chrome, but not Safari.  Any ideas how I can fix this so that all browsers will allow file uploads?  

Second, (might be more of a server question rather than a shiny question) our site works within our local network, but not off-site.  Any idea how to resolve this?  

Thanks in advance.  I am happy to see there is a user group here!
Barb
